title: Benchmark catalog
subtitle: Add a ready-made benchmark to your project in one click.
sectionFeaturedHint: Well-known public benchmarks, imported into your project.
sectionTryHint: Free examples that run on a scripted model. No keys needed.
sectionImportHint: Bring a dataset and we turn it into a suite.
cardFetchKnown: works, the public URL is prefilled
cardFetchAny: works with a public https link to that file
cardFetchNo: not possible (gated or needs extra steps); upload instead
fromHelp: For data already on the server (local mode or HEIMDALL_DATASETS_DIR). Relative paths resolve against your project folder.
uploadHelp: Expects: {{expects}}. Up to 64 MiB; a zip is unpacked. Stored in {{path}}, replacing the last upload.
urlHelp: The server downloads it (public https only, up to 64 MiB, 3 minute limit), then imports. Private data: download it and upload instead.
loadError: Could not load the catalog. Check the server is running, then reload.
empty: No benchmarks match. Clear the search or filters.
noSource: Examples and bundled suites are hidden: this server cannot find its bench folder (HEIMDALL_CATALOG_ROOT).
starter: New orgs start with these agents: {{agents}}.
importStarted: Import started. The suite appears when the job below finishes.
